column1: # Alt written 12 Aug 2026 from contact sheets 05, 06, 08, 09 and 10, plus
# direct renders of indices 54, 58, 59 and 60 — Rudra has three pairs that
# are near-identical at contact-sheet size (the two entrance frames, the
# two rooftops, and entrance-01 against lift-01, which are the same lobby
# from two positions) and they had to be told apart properly.
# Rudra is DELIVERED (§6.7): nothing here calls it under construction.
# The two rooftop frames show a bare concrete service level with stacked
# roofing sheets — described as what it is, without that implication.
# NOTE: §3.3's "Good" example is a Rudra rooftop with a parapet and an
# overhead water tank looking out to the hills. Neither rooftop photograph
# shows that. It was an illustration of the FORM, not a description of
# these files, and copying it would have been the exact defect §6.1 names.
# Two of these files are also used by the site-wide amenity bands in
# site.ts (rooftop-02 and parking-01) — the script rewrites those too.
